translations.A course can apply filters to a pool wit: A course can apply filters to a pool without changing the original pool. Typical filters are exam key, chapter key or a fixed list of question IDs. That is why a course pool can show fewer questions than the raw pool total.
translations.A course is the learning space for one c: A course is the learning space for one class or exam track. A pool is a set of questions. Courses can contain several pools, and the same pool can be reused in different contexts without rewriting the questions.
translations.A due card is ready for review again bas: A due card is ready for review again based on its current box and schedule. If no cards are due, the dashboard shows that you are caught up for now.
translations.A duel puts you head-to-head against ano: A duel puts you head-to-head against another learner.
translations.A duel starts either by creating a new d: A duel starts either by creating a new duel and sharing the code, or by joining an existing duel with that code. Both players then enter the lobby and have to mark themselves ready before the first question begins.
translations.A pool is locked when the course has at: A pool is locked when the course has at least one required and enforced pool that you have not completed yet. In that case, optional pools stay unavailable until every filtered question in the required pool was answered at least once.
translations.A streak tracks how many days in a row y: A streak tracks how many days in a row you stayed active. Milestones can trigger extra celebration feedback, but the core value is that it helps you stay consistent over time.
translations.After each answer you see whether it was: After each answer you see whether it was correct, which answer was right, and when available also an explanation or instructor note. That makes Training the fastest mode for learning from mistakes immediately.
translations.After the final score, you see the winne: After the final score, you see the winner and can start a rematch. If a duel was league-linked, the result is also written back into the league standings.
translations.After the regular season, the top four m: After the regular season, the top four move into the Champions League bracket. Those matches use the dedicated CL pool and the longer question count defined for the final round.
translations.After you answer, your choice stays visi: After you answer, your choice stays visible and the question waits until the opponent also finishes that round. Then both players get the short feedback screen before the next question starts.
translations.At the end you see your score, the numbe: At the end you see your score, the number of correct answers, XP gained, streak effects and possible badge unlocks. Training may also compare your result with your average and mark a personal best.
translations.Badges unlock when you meet certain lear: Badges unlock when you meet certain learning conditions. You can earn them through activity, consistency or mastery-related progress, and the UI shows both unlocked badges and progress toward future ones.
translations.Calendar Sync gives you an ICS URL that: Calendar Sync gives you an ICS URL that can be subscribed to in calendar apps. It is meant to surface due cards or study reminders outside the app. Regenerating the token invalidates the old URL.
translations.Challenges, standings, season flow and C: Challenges, standings, season flow and Champions League.
translations.Choose a course to open its learning mod: Choose a course to open its learning modes, leaderboard, league and duels. Each course can have its own assigned pools and rules.
translations.Choose a topic first. Then I will show t: Choose a topic first. Then I will show the most common questions inside it.
translations.Congratulations! You unlocked a new badg: Congratulations! You unlocked a new badge: {badgeName}
translations.Content Language changes the language us: Content Language changes the language used for question and answer content when translations are available. It does not change the general app interface language by itself.
translations.Content language, assistant toggle, cale: Content language, assistant toggle, calendar sync and preferences.
translations.Core basics about courses, pools, locks: Core basics about courses, pools, locks and language settings.
translations.Correct answers are what matter first. I: Correct answers are what matter first. If both players answer a question correctly, speed can decide the better outcome. After each question the score bar updates, so you can see the duel swing live.
translations.Create, join and understand direct head-: Create, join and understand direct head-to-head matches.
translations.Daily Challenge, notifications and relat: Daily Challenge, notifications and related toggles control how much extra guidance or reminder behavior you get. They do not rewrite your actual question data, but they can change how the app nudges and informs you.
translations.End Exam finishes the current attempt an: End Exam finishes the current attempt and saves the result based on what you answered so far. Abort discards the attempt instead, so no regular result is kept.
translations.Exam mode behaves like a test run: you c: Exam mode behaves like a test run: you choose a time limit and question count, complete one continuous session, and do not get immediate correctness feedback while answering. The detailed review comes only after the exam ends.
translations.Exam mode runs like a real exam: one ses: Exam mode runs like a real exam: one session, no immediate feedback, full review at the end.
translations.Failed to save support ticket answer: Failed to save support ticket answer
translations.Fast and correct answers matter: both ri: Fast and correct answers matter: both right means speed decides the higher score bonus.
translations.Here you can accept or start direct duel: Here you can accept or start direct duels. Once the duel starts, every answer counts and speed can break ties.

translations.How does the Leitner system work?: How does the Leitner system work?
translations.I give short tips right where they help: I give short tips right where they help most. You can turn me off any time in Personal Settings.
translations.I stay in the corner now. Open me any ti: I stay in the corner now. Open me any time for short explanations or quick FAQs.
translations.If Content Language is set in Personal S: If Content Language is set in Personal Settings, Learning tries to show translated question and answer texts in that language. If no translation exists, the original content is used.
translations.If disabled (recommended), only members: If disabled (recommended), only members of the configured instructor group get global instructor privileges.
translations.If the explain feature is available for: If the explain feature is available for your app setup, Training can request a short explanation for the current question after you answered it. This is meant as extra support, not as the authoritative source over the actual solution and instructor notes.
translations.If the time limit expires, the exam is a: If the time limit expires, the exam is auto-submitted by the server. You are then taken to the results and detailed review instead of continuing the question phase.
translations.Immediate feedback, question types and t: Immediate feedback, question types and the quickest way to practice.
translations.League logic can resolve unfinished or e: League logic can resolve unfinished or expired challenge situations through forfeit handling. That prevents the season from being blocked forever and lets the standings close cleanly.
translations.League play happens inside one course. E: League play happens inside one course. Everyone plays everyone, and the top 4 move on to the final round.
translations.Learning protects active exams from bein: Learning protects active exams from being answered in multiple tabs at the same time. If the exam is already active elsewhere, another tab can only show the state in read-only mode.
translations.Learning sessions can award XP. As XP gr: Learning sessions can award XP. As XP grows, your level increases and your progress bar moves toward the next threshold. This gives you a long-term sense of momentum across sessions.
translations.Leitner uses spaced repetition with 5 bo: Leitner uses spaced repetition with 5 boxes. Correct answers move a card into a higher box, wrong answers send it back. Higher boxes come back less often, so the system focuses your time on weak material.
translations.Mastery, leaderboard, XP, streaks and ba: Mastery, leaderboard, XP, streaks and badges.
translations.My Progress focuses on your own status i: My Progress focuses on your own status inside the course. It helps you see what you already mastered, how many questions you answered and where you still have weak areas.
translations.Open Duel appears once a challenge has b: Open Duel appears once a challenge has been accepted and a duel code already exists. At that point the match is ready to be played from inside the league tab itself.
translations.Open a course, choose a learning mode li: Open a course, choose a learning mode like Training or Leitner and then pick one of the assigned pools. The mode starts only after the pool selection, so the teacher controls the available material through course pools and optional filters.
translations.Open tickets wait for an admin reply. An: Open tickets wait for an admin reply. Answered tickets keep the latest response here.
translations.Pick a pool for fast true-or-false pract: Pick a pool for fast true-or-false practice. This mode is good for quick repetition and recognition.
translations.Pick a pool to review cards with spaced: Pick a pool to review cards with spaced repetition. The system will show difficult cards more often and mastered cards less often.
translations.Pick a pool to simulate an exam. You wil: Pick a pool to simulate an exam. You will finish the whole session first and only then see the full review.
translations.Pick a pool to start Training. You will: Pick a pool to start Training. You will get direct feedback after each answer, and required enforced pools may lock the optional ones until you finish them once.
translations.Question: Question
translations.Smart Queue combines due Leitner questio: Smart Queue combines due Leitner questions across pools and sorts them by priority, with the most urgent items first. It is useful when you want one focused review list instead of opening pools one by one.
translations.Spaced repetition, boxes, due cards and: Spaced repetition, boxes, due cards and remediation.
translations.Subject: Subject
translations.That one was rough. Tip: review your wea: That one was rough. Tip: review your weakest questions in Leitner Box 1 first and then try the exam again.
translations.The Leitner system sorts questions into: The Leitner system sorts questions into 5 boxes based on your learning progress. Correct answers move up, wrong answers go back to Box 1.
translations.The higher the box, the less often you r: The higher the box, the less often you review that card. That keeps practice focused and efficient.
translations.The leaderboard compares learners in the: The leaderboard compares learners in the same course. Depending on the view, it can show rank, XP, mastery and other activity indicators so you can see who is currently most active or strongest.
The leaderboard compares learners in the same course. XP, mastery and other activity indicators show who is currently ahead.
translations.The league exists inside one course. Lea: The league exists inside one course. Learners challenge each other, complete linked duels and earn points in a standings table. The season also has a separate Champions League pool for the final round.
translations.The league is course-specific. Challenge: The league is course-specific. Challenge classmates, collect points and watch the standings change after each finished duel.
translations.The player who creates the duel chooses: The player who creates the duel chooses the pool and the number of questions. The opponent joins that exact setup through the duel code.
translations.The review shows your score, correct and: The review shows your score, correct and wrong counts, time taken, questions per minute and a question-by-question breakdown. Depending on the question type, you can also see your own answer, the correct answer and instructor notes.
translations.The table tracks played matches, wins, l: The table tracks played matches, wins, losses, points and point difference. Points decide the ranking first, and point difference serves as the tie-breaker.
translations.These settings apply to all users of Lea: These settings apply to all users of Learning.
translations.This area shows your own progress in the: This area shows your own progress in the course, including mastery and answered questions. Use it to see where you still have gaps.
translations.Timed sessions, review flow, tab locking: Timed sessions, review flow, tab locking and completion rules.
translations.Training can include classic single-choi: Training can include classic single-choice questions, multiple-correct questions, free-text questions and PBQs. Multi-select questions need all correct options, free-text questions compare against a model answer, and PBQs use an interactive task component.
translations.Training is the low-pressure practice mo: Training is the low-pressure practice mode. You answer one question at a time, get feedback immediately and can repeat the pool as often as you want. It is best for quick drilling, familiarization and first passes through a topic.
translations.Training mode shows you all questions in: Training mode shows you all questions in the pool. Just start and learn without pressure.
translations.Trouble Spots is the remediation view. I: Trouble Spots is the remediation view. It collects questions that currently cause problems, so you can revisit weak points directly instead of running the full queue.
translations.UI Language affects the app interface la: UI Language affects the app interface labels and controls. Content Language affects the learning material itself, such as translated question text and answers. You can keep the interface in one language and the question content in another.
translations.Use Training when you want broad, low-pr: Use Training when you want broad, low-pressure practice inside one pool. Use Leitner when you want structured spaced repetition for one pool. Use Smart Queue when you want due questions from several pools in one prioritized review session.
translations.Welcome back! There are still questions: Welcome back! There are still questions waiting for you in the Leitner system.

translations.Yes. Personal Settings includes a Virtua: Yes. Personal Settings includes a Virtual assistant toggle. If you switch it off, the corner avatar and its automatic hints stop appearing until you enable it again.
You are inside a true-or-false session. Use it for fast repetition when you want to classify many statements quickly.
translations.You are inside an active Leitner pool. R: You are inside an active Leitner pool. Review the due cards first; new or difficult questions will come back sooner than mastered ones.
You are inside an active training pool. Start the session to answer mixed questions with direct feedback after every answer.
translations.You are inside an exam pool. Work throug: You are inside an exam pool. Work through the whole run first; explanations and correct answers are shown at the end.
translations.You are viewing a regular pool in Leitne: You are viewing a regular pool in Leitner mode. Use it to keep difficult questions coming back until they stick.
translations.You are viewing a regular pool in Traini: You are viewing a regular pool in Training mode. This is the fastest way to practice the pool with immediate feedback.
translations.You are viewing a regular pool in exam m: You are viewing a regular pool in exam mode. Treat it like a test run without instant correction.
translations.You are viewing a regular pool in true-o: You are viewing a regular pool in true-or-false mode. This is useful for fast recall training.
translations.You can keep learning here, and I can ex: You can keep learning here, and I can explain the most important modes and rules whenever you need a quick reminder.
translations.You challenge an opponent from the stand: You challenge an opponent from the standings, the opponent accepts it, and the system creates the linked duel. Incoming and outgoing challenges are shown separately so you can see what still needs action.
translations.Your message will be stored as a support: Your message will be stored as a support ticket with context, so an admin can answer it manually later.
translations.{days} days in a row. Consistency beats: {days} days in a row. Consistency beats intensity.
